text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So, I heard that back in your prime, you 
were pretty much invincible.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: "Why, thank you. I won't deny it."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What a shame. If I'd raced you back 
then... maybe this thirst would've been 
quenched a little.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm super intrigued too. I wonder how it 
would feel... to race against the freest 
running of that era?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Surely you're joking. Please, spare me 
the trouble."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
To compete with me, you say? It pains me 
to... shatter such an innocent dream.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Ha! ...Quite the bark. It seems the 
beast inside you is still hungry.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aha, nice. My heart is totally racing now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you should definitely run! You still 
have confidence you can pull it off... 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho ho. It seems you still do not 
understand.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume standing before you is 
crowned with unprecedented glory... Did 
you think you would be granted the honor 
of training alongside me so easily?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Then as long as I prove I've got the 
chops to devour you... there won't be any 
problem, right?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. I will be waiting for that day 
from the bottom of my heart.
